title: Academic Portfolio
text:
AI Use Statement
I believe generative AI can be a useful tool for learning when it supports rather than replaces my own thinking. I would use AI to help explain unfamiliar concepts, troubleshoot code, and identify possible mistakes in my work. However, I do not think AI should replace my own statistical reasoning or analysis. I should be able to understand and explain the work that I submit. I also think it is important to use AI critically and transparently. AI can provide incorrect or biased information, so I am responsible for checking its responses rather than accepting them automatically. This approach reflects the ASA’s emphasis on accountability, transparency, and integrity in statistical practice.
